episodes.title: And the Deadly Drekavac
episodes.summary: When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical Library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac. The Librarian, along with a quickly assembled team, must stop the Drekavac before it can kill and multiply.

episodes.title: And the Dance of Doom
episodes.summary: Our newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious "dancing sickness" leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

episodes.title: And the Ghost Train
episodes.summary: Half our Librarian team become trapped on a runaway ghost train. Can the rest of the team help solve the unresolved business of the ghosts onboard before the train completes a rampage of destruction?

episodes.title: And the Thief of Love
episodes.summary: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake. When they learn that a magical love artifact is behind the thefts, they enlist help from Vikram's old friend — Cupid himself.

episodes.title: And the Memory Crystal
episodes.summary: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

episodes.title: And the House of Cards
episodes.summary: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa, and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunnit while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

episodes.title: And the Con-Con
episodes.summary: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

episodes.title: And the Hangover from Hell
episodes.summary: After a wild bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover with no idea how they ended up where they are. They reconstruct the night by re-telling what they each do remember in order to figure out how they ended up here, and to prove to Lysa that her friend isn't who she said she is.

episodes.title: And the Feast of the Vampir
episodes.summary: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

episodes.title: And Going Medieval
episodes.summary: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 (via a homemade time machine), he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.

episodes.title: And the Graffiti of the Gods
episodes.summary: Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl, the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

episodes.title: And the Unfinished Business
episodes.summary: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal. The team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

episodes.title: And the Burning Heart
episodes.summary: When the Librarians are sent to an international boarding school to investigate an outbreak of inexplicable rage, they encounter a mysterious man claiming to be the legendary wizard Merlin. Together, the group must overcome their own anger and uncover the source of the magic before time runs out.

episodes.title: And the Tethered Wish
episodes.summary: A freed genie is granting wishes across Belgrade, leaving chaos in his wake. The Librarians must return the genie to his bottle before his magic spirals out of control... a task that proves difficult when Vikram makes a hasty wish, magically tethering himself to Jacob Stone.

episodes.title: And the Vanishing Bankers
episodes.summary: While investigating a spate of missing bankers in London, the Librarians discover a sinister new incarnation of Peter Pan is recruiting the next generation of Lost Boys. When Charlie becomes one of his captives, the team must venture into a twisted version of Neverland, disguising themselves as characters from Pan's world in a daring attempt to rescue her.

episodes.title: And the Recipe for Disaster
episodes.summary: When Connor is bewitched by a smell spell and becomes a contestant on a cooking competition show, the Librarians must break the enchantment by defeating the show's hosts.

episodes.title: And the Red Rock
episodes.summary: The Librarians discover that the charming scientist Lysa is dating is actually the Red Rock, a superhero battling a crime wave across Belgrade. Are his superpowers, and perhaps the crime wave itself, the result of a magical artifact being abused?

episodes.title: And Descartes' Nightmare
episodes.summary: While on a mission to recover the missing bracelets of Castor and Pollux, the Librarians accidentally swap bodies with one another. As they race to locate the second bracelet, they discover Merlin has secretly swapped bodies with one of them.

episodes.title: And the Monkey's Paw
episodes.summary: While pursuing a Monkey's Paw, the Librarians become trapped in a strange hotel shrouded in a mysterious fog. To escape, the team must confront past traumas, and, in the process, learn the difference between what they wish for and what they truly need.

episodes.title: And the Last Resort
episodes.summary: The Librarians investigate a magical ley line at a 200-year-old resort known for its venerable puppet theater. Their attempt to turn the mission into a vacation is thwarted when they uncover a sentient puppet's evil scheme to destroy the resort.

episodes.title: And the Toy Phone
episodes.summary: While the rest of the team is away on a Library retreat, Charlie receives a call on a mysterious toy phone from a child trapped in a haunted house. To save the child, Charlie must enlist the help of original Librarians Jacob Stone and Cassandra Cillian.

episodes.title: And the Heart of a Librarian
episodes.summary: The Librarians must help Vikram's long-lost love Anya unravel a mystery from the past -- through letters sent across time -- before the magical events she faces in the Victorian era ripple forward with consequences for the future.

episodes.title: And What Dreams May Come
episodes.summary: A distress call from Merlin leads the Librarians to a town where the entire population has mysteriously fallen asleep. As they search for the magical artifact behind the enchantment, the team is forced to confront their darkest nightmares brought vividly to life.

episodes.title: And the Camelot Conundrum
episodes.summary: The Librarians face their deadliest mission yet when a power-hungry Merlin returns to Camelot, determined to rewrite both the past and the future. Now, the team must stop the formidable wizard and prevent the collapse of time itself -- or die trying.
